sources.title: Zhangjiajie Grand Canyon and Glass Bridge: For a First Visit
sources.content:
Zhangjiajie Grand Canyon features a record-breaking glass bridge 260 meters above a canyon floor, offering transparent views of gorges, waterfalls, and forests.

Ticket Options & Pricing:
Grand Canyon Only: CNY 60 (canyon hiking, free boat ride)
Canyon + Glass Bridge: CNY 178
Canyon + Bridge + 7-Choose-5 Activities: CNY 298

Booking tip: Purchase tickets online in advance; reserve 1-2 days ahead during regular season, 3-5 days during peak.

Key Activities:
High-Altitude Zipline (included in combo): Spans 300 meters, duration 3-5 minutes, weight 30-90 kg
Glass Bridge Bungee Jump: CNY 2,998 first jump; 260 meters, world's highest commercial bungee, age 16-65
Via Ferrata Rock Climbing: CNY 138, 1-1.5 hours, entry-level difficulty
Additional: Sky Strip Slide Way, VR flying simulation, Rainbow Lake cruise

Hours: 8:00 AM - 3:30 PM (last entry)
Time needed: 40 minutes (bridge only) to 4+ hours (full experience)
Best times: Early morning before 9 AM or after 3 PM

Transportation from Wulingyuan: Coach CNY 12, 40-50 min; Taxi CNY 55, 35-45 min

What to Bring: Good grip shoes, portable raincoat, sun protection. Avoid glass bottles.

Recommended Routes: 3-4 hour full canyon; 40 min bridge only; 2-3 hour canyon-only hiking.

sources.title: Zhangjiajie Glass Bridge - Complete Visiting Guide 2026
sources.content: Zhangjiajie Glass Bridge complete visiting guide 2026. The bridge spans 430 meters across a deep valley and stands 300 meters above the canyon floor. Opened in 2016 as the world's longest and highest glass bridge. Staff provide felt booties to protect the glass surface. Only wallets and phones with protective cases allowed on the bridge. Strollers not permitted.

sources.title: Zhangjiajie Glass Bridge: Ultimate Guide & Travel Tips
sources.content: Zhangjiajie Glass Bridge ultimate guide. The best time to visit is spring (March-May) and autumn (September-November) for mild weather. Early June acts as a shoulder period with lighter crowds. Visitor numbers surge during July-August school vacation. The experience via the Yi Xia Tian pathway lasts approximately 2 hours.

sources.title: Zhangjiajie Glass Bridge: Tips, Cost, and 3-Day Itinerary
sources.content: Zhangjiajie Glass Bridge tips and cost guide with 3-day itinerary. First-hand experience crossing the glass bridge and exploring the grand canyon. The glass bridge is truly thrilling with incredible views. Recommend combining with Baofeng Lake for a full day. Book tickets in advance as they sell out.

sources.title: The Grand Canyon of Zhangjiajie (2026) - Tripadvisor
sources.content: Grand Canyon of Zhangjiajie visitor reviews. The glass bridge is a must-do experience. The canyon itself is beautiful with waterfalls and lush vegetation. The bungee jump is available for thrill seekers. Allow 2-4 hours depending on activities chosen. Book tickets online in advance.

sources.title: 云天渡_百度百科
sources.content:
云天渡（张家界大峡谷玻璃桥）位于中国湖南省张家界市慈利县三官寺土家族乡。始建于2014年，2016年8月20日投用。斜拉式悬索桥、玻璃桥、人行桥。

建筑规格：桥面宽度6米，桥面距谷底280余米，主跨430米，索塔4座最高40.65米，99块玻璃板，单块规格长4.42米×宽3.01米×厚5厘米重1.5吨，设计荷载800人。

票价138元人民币，日接待限流8000人。截至2018年6月累计接待620万游客。

全球首座空间索面大张开量悬索桥和以玻璃为主要受力结构的大型桥梁。集人行、游览、蹦极、溜索及舞台功能于一体。

荣誉：2016-2017年度中国国家优质工程奖；2018年阿瑟·海登奖（桥梁界最高荣誉）；2018年被CNN列入世界11座最壮观桥梁；2019年吉尼斯世界纪录世界最高人行桥。

sources.title: Zhangjiajie Grand Canyon and Glass Bridge Tickets Booking
sources.content: Zhangjiajie Grand Canyon and Glass Bridge tickets booking information. The scenic area offers multiple ticket options including bridge-only, canyon-only, and combination tickets. Activities include bungee jumping, zipline, and via ferrata climbing. Online booking recommended 1-3 days in advance. Transportation available from Wulingyuan town.
